issues.desc: CHK-001 wording is now product-facing, but the promised user-visible flow still fails. In the current repo state, `node bin/koala.js memory_benchmark_compare --candidateCounts=10000,100000,1000000 --queryCount=120 --seed=7 --format=text` returns `未知命令: memory_benchmark_compare`, and `lattice help` exposes no `memory_benchmark_*` command. The only traced implementation remains the deterministic virtual benchmark from B-d4dd (`packages/main/src/core/memory-benchmark.ts` and `.koala/story/actives/B-d4dd/summary.json`), which does not provide one real-data baseline flow with auditable non-empty corpus/gold/query/result artifacts plus boundary-enforcement and validation behavior. CHK-001 is therefore still not user-observable yet.
